title: vigil-sre · Threshold calibration
description: What share of each target's probes each candidate backend threshold would flag, computed over every probe in the mounted database. The time-series panel opens on the last 7 days; widen the range if the mounted database holds older probes.

panels.title: Backend: % of probes that would exceed each threshold
panels.description: Each cell is the firing rate if that value were the threshold, over every probe in the mounted database that has a backend time. The '500 ms (current)' column is what the monitor applies by default: a target whose rate there is high is being flagged for its normal operation, not for an anomaly.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  url AS target,
  COUNT(*) AS samples,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "500 ms (current)",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 750 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "750 ms",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "1000 ms",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 1500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "1500 ms",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "2000 ms",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN server_processing_ms > 3000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*), 1) AS "3000 ms"
FROM probe_results
WHERE server_processing_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY url ORDER BY url

panels.title: Backend median against the current threshold
panels.description: Each target's median backend time over every probe in the mounted database, minus the default threshold (500 ms). A positive margin means the threshold sits BELOW the target's median: it does not measure an anomaly, it measures normal operation. A threshold like that cannot be silenced without turning the whole rule off. A target that sets degraded_backend_ms is judged against its own value, not this one.

targets.queryText:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT url, server_processing_ms AS v,
         CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY url ORDER BY server_processing_ms) AS cd
  FROM probe_results WHERE server_processing_ms IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT url AS target,
  ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.50 THEN v END)) AS p50,
  500 AS current_threshold,
  ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN cd >= 0.50 THEN v END))
    - 500 AS margin
FROM r GROUP BY url ORDER BY margin DESC
targets.rawQueryText:

    - 500 AS margin
FROM r GROUP BY url ORDER BY margin DESC

panels.title: Backend time distribution
panels.description: How each target's backend times are distributed. If a target's mass sits to the right of the threshold, the threshold does not fit that target.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  CAST(strftime('%s', run_started_at) AS INTEGER) AS time,
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.google.com' THEN server_processing_ms END) AS "google.com",
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.github.com' THEN server_processing_ms END) AS "github.com",
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://www.cloudflare.com' THEN server_processing_ms END) AS "cloudflare.com",
  AVG(CASE WHEN url = 'https://httpbin.org/status/200' THEN server_processing_ms END) AS "httpbin.org"
FROM probe_results
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Backend over time, with the current threshold marked
panels.description: The red line is the default backend threshold, TTFB_BACKEND_SLACK_MS = 500 in diagnostics.py. A probe above it is flagged SLOW_BACKEND unless its target sets degraded_backend_ms.
